title: Can Language Models Learn When to Abstain? Policy Learning and Calibrated Answer Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.13821v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A useful language model should know when to answer and when to say "I don't know." Can we improve that decision by training the model itself or by training a separate component to check its answers? We study both approaches on Qwen3-14B for factual questions, using a score that rewards correct answers, penalizes mistakes, and allows abstention. Across three training seeds and two held-out confidence thresholds, a learned answer selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the original model's calibrated confidence filter. On TriviaQA, mean coverage increases from 20.2% to 30.9%, while the pooled error rate among scored answers decreases from 23.0% to 14.5% under exact-match grading. The tested reinforcement-learning changes do not establish consistent gains. On NQ-Open, the selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the filter but still performs worse than always abstaining. A partial human-reviewed audit preserves the Trivia

translated_title: 语言模型能学会何时放弃回答吗？策略学习与校准的答案选择
translated_abstract: 一个有用的语言模型应当知道何时回答问题，何时说“我不知道”。我们能否通过训练模型本身，或训练一个独立组件来检查其答案，从而改进这一决策？我们在Qwen3-14B上针对事实性问题研究了这两种方法，采用一种对正确答案给予奖励、对错误答案进行惩罚、并允许放弃回答的评分标准。在三个训练种子和两个保留置信度阈值的设置下，学习得到的答案选择器在阈值平均效用上优于原始模型的校准置信度过滤器。在TriviaQA上，平均覆盖率从20.2%提升至30.9%，而在精确匹配评分下，已评分答案的合并错误率从23.0%降至14.5%。所测试的强化学习改动并未带来一致的增益。在NQ-Open上，选择器在阈值平均效用上优于过滤器，但仍逊于始终放弃回答的策略。一项部分经过人工审核的审计保留了Trivia（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出通过训练一个独立的答案选择器来决定语言模型何时作答、何时放弃，其在TriviaQA上显著优于模型自身的置信度过滤和强化学习方法，将覆盖率从20.2%提升至30.9%、错误率从23.0%降至14.5%。
en_tdlr: Training a separate learned answer selector improves language models' decisions on when to answer versus abstain—outperforming both calibrated confidence filtering and reinforcement-learning approaches—raising TriviaQA coverage from 20.2% to 30.9% while reducing error rate from 23.0% to 14.5%.
